title: Masked Visual Actions: released-checkpoint controllability reproduction
description: With matched controls and seeds, the released MVA LoRAs beat their Wan2.2-Fun-A14B-Control base model on reconstruction and robot-trajectory adherence on every real and simulated subset (robot-region PSNR +3.5 to +12.2 dB), dense masked controls beat sparse ones, and the advantage grows on held-out embodiments.
